ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let free = source.getVariable() == "1"
let data = JSON.parse(result).data
let bid = baseUrl.match(/bookId=(\d+)/)[1]
let chapterList = []
data['vs'].forEach(list => {
  chapterList.push({
    name: String(list.vN),
    voltype: true
  })
  list['cs'].forEach(chapter => {
    let isVip = chapter.sS!="1" && !free ? "🔒":""
    let href = `https://vipreader.qidian.com/chapter/${bid}/${chapter.id}/`
    let url = list.hS == true || free ? `${href},{'webView': true}` : href
    chapterList.push({
      name: String(isVip+chapter.cN).trim().replace(/^(\d+)(?![\s\d卷部章节回.])/, '$1 ').replace(/\s+/g, " "),
      url: url,
      info: `更新时间: ${chapter.uT} 字数: ${chapter.cnt}`,
      voltype: false
    })
  })
})
chapterList
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let free = source.getVariable() == "1"
let data = JSON.parse(result).data
let bid = baseUrl.match(/bookId=(\d+)/)[1]
let chapterList = []
data['vs'].forEach(list => {
  chapterList.push({
    name: String(list.vN),
    voltype: true
  })
  list['cs'].forEach(chapter => {
    let isVip = chapter.sS!="1" && !free ? "🔒":""
    let href = `https://vipreader.qidian.com/chapter/${bid}/${chapter.id}/`
    let url = list.hS == true || free ? `${href},{'webView': true}` : href
    chapterList.push({
      name: String(isVip+chapter.cN).trim().replace(/^(\d+)(?![\s\d卷部章节回.])/, '$1 ').replace(/\s+/g, " "),
      url: url,
      info: `更新时间: ${chapter.uT} 字数: ${chapter.cnt}`,
      voltype: false
    })
  })
})
chapterList
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
(function() {
let novelId = java.hexDecodeToString(result)
let type = JSON.parse(baseUrl.slice(baseUrl.indexOf('{'))).type

if (type == 'novel') {
  book.type = 8
  let loginInfo = JSON.parse(source.getLoginInfo() || '{}')
  loginInfo.书籍ID = novelId
  source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(loginInfo))
} else if (type == 'comic') {
  book.type = 64
} else if (type == 'audio') {
  book.type = 32
}

// 主目录和普通章节仍走 qd.vv9v.cn；彩蛋只走 qdApi/qdList。
let catalog = requestApiUrl(`/${type}/catalog`, { novelId }) || []

let midpageEnabled = false
let midpageEntries = []
try {
  let m = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : null
  let v = m && (m.get ? m.get("\u5f69\u86cb\u7ae0\u5f00\u5173") : m["\u5f69\u86cb\u7ae0\u5f00\u5173"])
  midpageEnabled = type === 'novel' && v != null && String(v) === "✅"
  let listFn = typeof qdList === 'function' ? qdList : function(x) { return Array.isArray(x) ? x : [] }
  if (midpageEnabled && typeof qdApi === 'function') {
    let midRes = qdApi.call(this, 'midpage_chapters', { book_id: novelId }) || {}
    let midData = midRes.data || midRes.Data || (midRes.raw && (midRes.raw.Data || midRes.raw.data)) || {}
    let midpageList = listFn(midData.Chapters || midData.chapters || midData.DataList || midData.MidpageChapters || midData.MidPageChapters)
    for (let mp of midpageList) {
      mp = mp || {}
      let targetId = mp.ChapterId || mp.C || mp.chapterId
      if (!targetId) continue
      let eggs = listFn(mp.MidpageList || mp.MidPageList || mp.PageList || mp.Pages || mp.List)
      if (!eggs.length) continue
      for (let egg of eggs) {
        try {
          egg = egg || {}
          let cfg = egg.MidPageConfig || egg.MidpageConfig || {}
          let eggName = egg.MidPageName || egg.MidpageName || egg.Title || egg.RoleName || cfg.PageName || cfg.Title || "彩蛋内容"
          eggName = String(eggName).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').replace(/^彩蛋章[ ·]*/, '')
          let midpageId = egg.PageId || egg.MidPageId || egg.MidpageId || cfg.PageId || cfg.MidPageId || ''
          if (!midpageId) continue
          let chapterId = String(targetId)
          midpageId = String(midpageId)
          let eggKey = 'midpage:' + String(novelId) + ':' + chapterId + ':' + midpageId
          let eggUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(String(eggKey))},{"type":"novel","novelId":"${String(novelId)}","chapterId":"${chapterId}","qimoType":"midpage","midpageId":"${midpageId}"}`
          midpageEntries.push({
            id: eggKey,
            name: '彩蛋章 · ' + eggName,
            url: String(eggUrl),
            info: '官方插图/视频',
            isVolume: false,
            isVip: false,
            isPay: false
          })
        } catch (entryError) {
          try { java.log('忽略异常彩蛋数据: ' + entryError.message) } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
    }
  }
} catch (e) {
  midpageEnabled = false
  midpageEntries = []
  try { java.log('彩蛋 qdApi 处理失败，忽略彩蛋：' + e.message) } catch (_) {}
}

let cache = (requestApiUrl(`/${type}/cache`, { novelId }) || []).reduce((acc, d) => {
  acc[d.chapId] = d
  return acc
}, {})

function fmtTime(timestamp) {
  let date = new Date(timestamp)
  let year = date.getFullYear()
  let month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  let day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  let hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')
  let minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${year}-${month}-${day} ${hours}:${minutes}`
}

let chaps = []
if (type === 'novel') {
  for (let volumeIndex = 0; volumeIndex < catalog.length; volumeIndex++) {
    let volume = catalog[volumeIndex] || {}
    let volumeKey = 'volume:' + String(novelId) + ':' + String(volumeIndex)
    chaps.push({
      id: volumeKey,
      name: volume.volumeName,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(volumeKey)},{"type":"volume"}`,
      isVolume: true
    })
    for (let chapter of (volume.chapters || [])) {
      let { chapId, chapName, charCount, isVip, isBuy, displayTime } = chapter
      let isShare = cache[chapId]
      chaps.push({
        id: chapId,
        name: (isVip ? (isBuy ? ' 🔑 ' : isShare ? '  🍋 ' : '') : '') + chapName,
        url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(chapId)},{"type":"${type}","novelId":"${novelId}"}`,
        info: `${fmtTime(displayTime)} | ${charCount || 0}字 ${isShare ? '  🍋 ' : isBuy ? ' 🔑 ' : ''}`,
        isVip: !isShare && isVip,
        isPay: !!isBuy,
      })

    }
  }
}

if (midpageEnabled && midpageEntries.length) {
  let midpageVolumeKey = 'volume:' + String(novelId) + ':midpage'
  chaps.push({
    id: midpageVolumeKey,
    name: '彩蛋章',
    url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(midpageVolumeKey)},{"type":"volume"}`,
    isVolume: true
  })
  chaps = chaps.concat(midpageEntries)
}

return JSON.stringify(chaps)
})();
</js>

<js>
function updateNextPageLink(html) {
    // Regex to match the "下一页" link with javascript:Next
    let r = /<a\s+class="am-btn\s+am-btn-default\s+am-radius"\s+href="([^"]+)">下一页<\/a>/;

    // Check if the regex matches the "下一页" link
    let match = html.match(r);

    if (match) {
        // Extract the href value from the match
        let hrefValue = match[1];

        // Check if the href contains "javascript:Next"
        if (hrefValue.includes("javascript:Next")) {
            // Use a regex to extract the parameters from the javascript:Next() call
            let paramRegex = /javascript:Next\('(\d+)','([^']+)'\)/;
            let paramMatch = hrefValue.match(paramRegex);

            if (paramMatch) {
                let id = paramMatch[1];      // Extract the first parameter ('220571')
                let file = paramMatch[2];    // Extract the second parameter ('30233653_2.html')

                // Construct the new href value
                let newHref = `/read/${id}/${file}`;

                // Replace the old href with the new one in the <a> tag
                let newLink = match[0].replace(hrefValue, newHref);

                // Replace the old <a> tag with the new one in the HTML
                html = html.replace(match[0], newLink);
            }
        }
    }

    // Return the updated or original HTML
    return html;
}

let final = updateNextPageLink(result);
final</js>

<js>
let regex = /<ul class="am-avg-sm-1 am-avg-md-2 am-avg-lg-4 am-list">(.*?)<\/ul>/s;
let list = result.match(regex)[0]

// Regex to find and replace javascript:Chapter hrefs
let update = list.replace(/href="javascript:Chapter\('(\d+)','(.*?)'\)"/g, (match, chapterId, fileName) => {
    // Construct the new href
    let newHref = `/read/${chapterId}/${fileName}`;
    
    // Return the new href format
    return `href="${newHref}"`;
});


function processHtml(html, update) {
    // Regex to detect the "下一页" link
    let r = /<a\s+class="index-container-btn"\s+href="([^"]+)">下一页<\/a>/;
    
    // Check if the regex matches the "下一页" link
    let match = html.match(r);

    if (match) {
        // If "下一页" is detected, append it to the update
        let next = match[0];  // Full <a> tag with "下一页"
        let final = update + next;
        return final;
    } else {
        // If no "下一页" is detected, return the update as is
        return update;
    }
}


end =processHtml(result, update)
end</js>

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

var category = function () {
